name: react-portfolio
description: A professional portfolio application built with React.

scripts.build: npm run clean && esbuild index.tsx --bundle --outdir=dist --splitting --format=esm --loader:.tsx=tsx --external:react --external:react-dom --external:react-router-dom --external:@heroicons/react/* && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('index.html','dist/index.html'); fs.cpSync('assets','dist/assets',{recursive:true});"
scripts.start: npm run build && npx --yes serve -s dist -l 8000
